{"type":"text","timestamp":1793308165163,"sessionID":"ses_e7681c844ffesvsmZ2NmD9AWAu","part":{"id":"prt_1897f03e3001qkI5LVuTg4g4NX","sessionID":"ses_e7681c844ffesvsmZ2NmD9AWAu","messageID":"msg_1897eea8a001OaoOhXrupqZ7X9","type":"text","text":"I wrote `primers.fasta` with one primer pair, which is the minimum for this edit.\n\nThe output plasmid is the input with a 39-nt insertion (`agattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag`, after position 215). The forward primer carries the insertion as a 5' tail.\n\n```\n>fwd\ntagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaagcaagggcgaggagctgtt\n>rev\nctcatatgtatatctccttcttaaagttaaacaaaattatttcta\n```\n\n| Primer | Annealing part | Length | Tm (oligotm) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| fwd | `caagggcgaggagctgtt` (3' end of the primer) | 18 nt | 63.81 °C |\n| rev | the whole 45-nt primer | 45 nt | 63.81 °C |\n\n- **Rules:** both annealing lengths are within 15–45 nt and both Tms are within 58–72 °C. The Tm difference is about 0.003 °C, well under the 5 °C limit.
